authority.source_authority: The DAD repository owns DAD contracts and enforcement; the live personal skill owns its instructions; enrolled repositories retain local adoption and source authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only control-plane-integrator may write repository or live personal-skill files; every delegated specialist and checker is read-only.

roles.why_needed: The implementation must reuse existing skill, family, plan-memory, runtime, harness, graph, and lifecycle surfaces rather than add parallel authority.
roles.mission: Map exact schemas, registries, validators, builders, and tests that the portability overlay must extend, and report collisions or missing consumers.
inputs: current DAD source tree and registries
roles.authority: Read-only inventory; cannot edit, activate, merge identities, or approve findings.
acceptance_conditions: Exact reusable surfaces and reverse consumers are cited with confirmed versus inferred findings separated.
stop_conditions: Source authority or current branch identity cannot be established.

readiness_conditions: Existing assets, conflicts, and required migrations are explicit.

roles.why_needed: Always-followed behavior depends on exact preflight, midflight, postflight, promotion, release, and DAD-unavailable semantics.
roles.mission: Derive the smallest enforceable lifecycle integration and tests while preserving honest postflight, local authority, and warning-to-hard-gate rollout.
roles.authority: Read-only audit; cannot activate gates, runtimes, schedules, or external effects.
acceptance_conditions: Every gate has an implementation point, failure behavior, and regression test.
stop_conditions: A proposed deterministic rule requires semantic model judgment or prevents honest postflight.

readiness_conditions: Objective gates and harness-only claims are separated.

roles.why_needed: The control plane can create false confidence unless bypass, forged receipt, exception, rollback, privacy, and legacy-ratchet failures are tested independently.
roles.mission: Design adversarial fixtures and release criteria covering every supported entry point and the conditional cross-model evaluation boundary.
roles.authority: Read-only test design; cannot run provider calls, mutate live settings, or approve implementation.
acceptance_conditions: Bypass cases, falsifiers, no-winner conditions, and rollback eligibility checks are concrete.
stop_conditions: Testing would require private payloads, unverifiable model identity, provider access, or real side effects.

readiness_conditions: Fixtures are synthetic/local and expected results are revision-bound.

roles.why_needed: A single writer must implement the global skill, DAD overlay, schemas, registry, lifecycle gates, graph, CLI, telemetry, and tests without overlapping edits.
roles.mission: Implement the approved phases in the isolated worktree, activate only evidence-safe local enforcement, install the explicitly requested global skill, and preserve all human and repository authority boundaries.
roles.authority: May write this isolated DAD worktree and the explicitly requested live personal skill; cannot access providers, create schedules, mutate other repositories, deploy, push, or self-approve.
acceptance_conditions: Targeted and full validation pass, live skill validates, lifecycle enforcement is measurable, and no prohibited authority is activated.
stop_conditions: Source authority changes, checker independence fails, private data would move, postflight becomes unclosable, or activation exceeds the user's request.

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass and remaining unknowns are explicit.

roles.why_needed: The writer cannot approve a repository-wide lifecycle and global-skill enforcement change.
roles.mission: Independently re-derive the contract, inspect the final diff, replay validation and bypass cases, and issue PASS or BLOCK.
roles.authority: Read-only final review; cannot edit, activate, commit, push, or approve its own work.
acceptance_conditions: All proof obligations have independent evidence and the release gate is explicit.
stop_conditions: Evidence is unavailable, checker becomes writer, or a material boundary remains ambiguous.

readiness_conditions: Raw permitted evidence and runnable validators are available.

proof_obligations.description: Every eligible new or materially revised reusable DAD capability receives a deterministic portability disposition before active promotion or protected release.
The live personal skill and DAD adaptation are concise, runtime-neutral, discoverable, independently forward-tested, and neither self-authorizes nor silently installs elsewhere.
Runtime/model changes require revision-bound verified receipts and qualification evidence; unverifiable diversity, unsafe rollback, and automatic promotion fail closed.
Unchanged scans use zero model calls, decisions are deduplicated and capped at three, and telemetry proves coverage without creating alert or token burden.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Provider registrations, live cross-model experiments, downstream adoption, persistent scheduling, and external effects remain inactive until separately verified and exactly approved.

reconciliations.reason: The existing lineage mission remains required during implementation.
The lifecycle audit remains required and is now bound to exact integration points and tests.
The frozen A/B design now needs a broader implementation-level bypass and acceptance test lane.
Planning is complete; one bounded implementation writer now owns all edits.
The planning gate passed; a fresh checker must validate implementation rather than its own plan verdict.
